# Acknowledgments {.unnumbered}

## NIST

This edition would not exist without the original
[NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/),
a public resource produced and maintained by the National Institute of
Standards and Technology in collaboration with SEMATECH. See the
"Copyright" appendix for NIST's full statement on the use of its materials.

The acknowledgments below are reproduced from the original e-Handbook's own
[Acknowledgements](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/acknwldg.htm)
page, crediting everyone who built the source material this edition is
based on.

### Origins of the e-Handbook

The e-Handbook's origins trace back to the work of Mary Natrella — see
[Origins of the e-Handbook in the Work of Mary Natrella](natrella.pdf) for
the full account.
